poses.caption: Support hips in front of bench with one hand and both heels on floor
Bend the working elbow to lower hips, keeping the other arm across chest

jobs.detail: ONE ARM BENCH DIP, TWO phases. Three-quarter side view, same gray sturdy bench BEHIND hips IMAGE LEFT, body in front bench with straight legs extending IMAGE RIGHT and BOTH heels on floor. Body faces AWAY from bench. Only ONE working hand (RIGHT) plants on FRONT EDGE bench immediately behind same-side hip, fingers pointing FORWARD toward feet/body, palm firmly contacts edge. LEFT nonworking arm crosses chest and hand rests on right chest, never contacts bench/floor. Feet hip width, knees extended throughout, toes up heels floor. LEFT TOP: working elbow nearly straight supports hips just forward of bench, back close to bench front edge. RIGHT BOTTOM: bend only working elbow to about90degrees lowering hips vertically toward floor, back close bench edge, upper arm near torso. Same hand location, bench, feet and camera unchanged; no torso rotation, no second hand assistance. Red EXPOSED posterior RIGHT upper-arm TRICEPS only; other exposed muscles grayscale fine fibers. No red on clothes. Full body and whole bench within each panel with white margins. No captions/arrows.

poses.caption: Hold the medicine ball at waist height with the right hand
Raise the ball overhead with the right arm
Drive the ball downward and release toward the floor; catch the rebound to repeat

jobs.detail: ONE ARM MEDICINE BALL SLAM, THREE phases, whole body and single same gray round medicine ball within each panel. SAME full body three-quarter side camera. Feet shoulder width, knees soft. ONLY RIGHT hand works; LEFT nonworking hand stays on LEFT HIP in EVERY phase, never holds ball. LEFT PREPARATION: right hand cups ONE ball from underneath in front of waist, torso upright slight bent knees. MIDDLE OVERHEAD: RIGHT arm extends overhead holding ball high in open right palm, secure one-hand grasp, left hand remains hip; no second ball. RIGHT SLAM RELEASE: torso hinges forward about40degrees, knees flex, right arm swings downward extended toward floor in front of feet with palm/fingers open after release; ONE ball FREE just above floor directly in front, about to strike floor, clearly separated from right hand. No ball overhead in last phase, no duplicates or trails/arrows. Catch rebound and repeat not additional pose. Primary ABS only soft diffuse blurred red tint on intact opaque black abdominal shirt, NO sixpack lines/radial fibers/clothing cutaway. Fine grayscale exposed muscles, full opaque shirt/shorts wrap front sides back seat crotch. Generous white margins including overhead ball and shoes. No text.
